title: Rural Home Loans Replacement Remittance: the Escrow Share
content:
Rural Home Loans: escrow administration answers on the escrow share a replacement remittance carries for a reopened monthly payment.

## Rule

The escrow share the replacement carries is chosen as follows: when escrow is not waived and the loan's latest escrow analysis is dated later than the due date of the reopened monthly payment, the share is the escrow deposit that the return reversed; when escrow is waived on the loan, the share is nothing; otherwise the share is the monthly escrow deposit on the loan record.

## Questions and answers

**Which due date is compared?** The due date of the reopened monthly payment, as shown on the return entries of the most recent returned remittance.

**Which analysis date?** The date of the loan's latest escrow analysis on the loan record. An analysis dated on the same day as the due date is not later than it.

**What is "the escrow deposit that the return reversed"?** The amount on the escrow deposit return entry of that returned remittance.

**What if escrow has been waived?** The share is nothing, whatever the analysis date.

## Table

| Escrow waived | Latest analysis later than the reopened due date | Escrow share |
|---|---|---|
| no | yes | the escrow deposit the return reversed |
| no | no | the monthly escrow deposit on the loan record |
| yes | either | nothing |

## Worked case (hypothetical records)

A monthly payment due on the first of a month with a 395.00 escrow share was returned; an analysis later in that month raised the monthly escrow deposit on the record to 430.00. The analysis is dated later than the due date, so the escrow share is the 395.00 the return reversed. Had the latest analysis been dated before that due date, the share would be the 430.00 on the record.
